title: Quant-suite throughput & p95 regression detection across FP16/INT8/INT4
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a repeatable benchmarking suite and CI-integrated load harness to measure throughput (tokens/sec), latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), and quality deltas for FP16, INT8, and INT4 quantization profiles. The goal is automated regression detection that flags quality or tail-latency regressions during quant rollout while showing unit-cost trade-offs.
background: We already have ad-hoc quant sweeps (INT8/INT4) and performance snapshots, but lack a reproducible, production-like harness that correlates tokens/sec and p95 tail latency with objective quality metrics. Recent model rollouts showed unexpected p95 degradation under concurrency spikes. This ticket creates a canonical test matrix and automated gating logic for quant profiles.
goals: 1) Create a parameterized load harness that runs deterministic experiments across quant profiles; 2) Surface tokens/sec and p95 deltas vs FP16 baseline; 3) Compute quality regressions using embedding similarity and task-specific metrics; 4) Add statistical/regression rules and CI alerts; 5) Publish dashboards and runbook.
success_metrics:
- Harness produces reproducible runs within ±3% tokens/sec variance on same infra
- Automated regression detector fires when quality metric drops >2% absolute or p95 increases >20%
- Baseline FP16 vs INT8/INT4 trade-off table for at least 3 model families (Llama-2, Mistral, Open weights)
- Integration into nightly CI and a dashboard with historical trendlines
approach: 1) Define test matrix (models, seq lengths, batch sizes, concurrency, GPU type). 2) Implement driver that records per-request token counts, generation time, and token-level timing to compute tokens/sec and percentiles. 3) Add quality evaluation: (a) embedding cosine similarity against FP16 output, (b) proxy metrics (perplexity, rouge or exact-match where available). 4) Run controlled load experiments: cold and warm KV cache scenarios. 5) Implement regression logic: bootstrap confidence intervals and non-parametric tests (Mann-Whitney) for p95 and quality; threshold-based alerts for ops.
test_matrix: Models: [llama-2-13b, misa-7b, open-30b]; Sequence lengths: [64, 256, 1024]; Batch sizes: [1,4,8]; Concurrent clients: [1,8,32]; Quant profiles: [FP16 baseline, INT8 profile-A, INT8 profile-B, INT4 aggressive]; GPU types: [A100-40GB, H100-80GB, GTX-like dev unit]; Cache states: [cold, warm].
harness_changes:
- Extend existing load harness to emit tokens/sec per-second time series and per-request token latency
- Add sampler to capture predictions for downstream quality eval
- Parameterize kernel variant and quantization flags for runtime to pick kernel combos
- Add synthetic driver for controlled concurrency spikes and a replay driver for production traces
data_and_prompts:
- Use a curated set of 2k short, 1k medium, and 500 long prompts sampled from production telemetry (anonymized)
- Include evaluation prompts for summarization, completions, and instruction-following tasks
- Hold-out datasets for quality baselines and manual spot checks
evaluation_plan:
- Run three full passes: development (small), nightly (full matrix), pre-release (stability runs)
- For quality: compute embedding cosine similarity to FP16 outputs and task-specific metrics where available
- For perf: compute tokens/sec overall and per-second time series; p50/p95/p99 latencies; compute cost per 1k tokens estimate
- Regression detection: compare current run to rolling baseline of last 7 successful runs using CI and threshold rules
acceptance_criteria:
- End-to-end harness runs produce JSON artifacts with tokens/sec and percentile metrics
- Quality metrics saved and compared automatically to baseline
- Regression detector implemented and tested with synthetic regressions (injected noise)
- Nightly job created in CI that posts results to performance dashboard and opens an alert PR when thresholds are crossed
- Documentation: README for running experiments and a runbook for interpreting alerts
rollout_plan:
1) Merge harness and lightweight dashboard (week 1)
2) Run nightly full-matrix for two weeks and tune thresholds (week 2-3)
3) Enable CI gating for quant profile merges with auto-block (week 4)
4) Hand over runbook to SRE/Release engineers
risks_mitigation:
- Risk: noisy measurements from multi-tenant infra -> Mitigation: run on reserved nodes or use Dedicated test pool
- Risk: quality metric mismatch to human judgment -> Mitigation: keep manual spot checks and add specific task metrics
- Risk: false positives from transient infra events -> Mitigation: require 2 consecutive nightly failures before auto-block

2025-01-29: Added embedding-similarity quality checker and small eval set. Baseline FP16 runs completed on A100 dev pool.
2025-02-02: Implemented regression detector and synthetic regression injection harness; initial thresholds suggest p95 >20% increase as alerting heuristic.
2025-02-05: Dashboard prototype in Grafana with tokens/sec and p95 trendlines. Preparing nightly CI job. Assigned Miguel to finalize CI integration.
notes: This ticket focuses on the engineering-grade harness and regression logic. Separate follow-ups will convert the harness outputs into cost-optimization suggestions (Optimize team) and a customer-facing quant guide (Docs). Expect to collaborate closely with SRE for reserved capacity runs.
